entries.title: LibreOffice Headless Fallback for Legacy Office Formats
entries.claim_source: src/content/FUTURE_ENHANCEMENTS.md — PDF and Office Document Text Extraction section
entries.expected: Spawn soffice --headless to convert legacy .doc/.xls/.ppt to text in a sandboxed subprocess (posix_spawn, restricted OS user, 30 s timeout)
entries.observed: RESOLVED: OfficeProcessor::extractLegacyViaLibreOffice() implemented using posix_spawn (no system()); POSIX_SPAWN_RESETIDS + POSIX_SPAWN_SETPGROUP + POSIX_SPAWN_SETSIGDEF; full 8-byte OLE header validation; RAII temp-file cleanup; minimal sandboxed environment (HOME=tmpdir); 30 s SIGTERM->SIGKILL timeout
entries.impact: Legacy .doc/.xls/.ppt files are now extracted via LibreOffice headless.

entries.title: MimeDetector-Triggered OCR via ContentPolicy
entries.expected: MimeDetector triggers OCR for image/png, image/jpeg, image/tiff when ContentPolicy::ocrEnabled() == true for the collection
entries.observed: RESOLVED: ContentPolicy::ocr_enabled + ocrEnabled() added. MimeDetector::shouldTriggerOcr() and enableOcr() implemented. ContentManager::ingestRawBlob() routes via mime_detector_.shouldTriggerOcr().
entries.impact: OCR is automatically triggered during ingestion when config["ocr_enabled"]=true.

entries.title: OCR Pre-Processing: DPI Rescaling to 300 DPI
entries.expected: Rescale images to 300 DPI before OCR if metadata indicates lower resolution; apply adaptive binarisation via Leptonica
entries.observed: RESOLVED: OcrProcessor::Config has target_dpi=300, enable_dpi_rescaling=true, enable_adaptive_binarization=true. runTesseract() uses pixGetXRes/pixGetYRes; pixScale for upscaling; pixSauvolaBinarize (31x31, k=0.35).
evidence: src/content/ocr_processor.cpp: DPI detection and rescaling in runTesseract()
entries.impact: OCR quality on low-resolution scans is improved via pre-processing normalisation.

entries.title: OCR Language Pack Path Not Constrained to config/ai_ml/tesseract_lang/
entries.expected: Language packs loaded from config/ai_ml/tesseract_lang/; default eng; configurable per-collection
entries.observed: RESOLVED: runTesseract() uses ConfigPathResolver::tryResolve("config/ai_ml/tesseract_lang") when config_.data_dir is empty. PATH_MAPPING entry added for config/tesseract_lang legacy alias.
entries.impact: Consistent deployment; operators do not need to configure the path manually.

entries.title: Streaming Ingestion Back-Pressure Not Implemented
entries.expected: ingestStream() blocks the caller when the worker queue depth exceeds config_.max_queue_depth; returns a std::future<ContentId> for async callers
entries.observed: RESOLVED: AsyncIngestionConfig::max_queue_depth added (default 1000). submitStream() blocks via condition_variable when queue full. ingestStream() returns std::future<string>. stop() broadcasts backpressure_cv_ on shutdown.
entries.impact: Queue depth is respected; no unbounded queue growth under load.

entries.title: Zip-Bomb Protection in archive_processor.cpp
entries.expected: content_security.cpp scans all uploaded archives for zip-bomb patterns; enforce max decompressed-to-compressed ratio of 100x and max extracted file count of 1,000
entries.observed: RESOLVED: ContentSecurityManager::checkZipBomb() enforces ratio 100x, max 1 000 files. ArchiveProcessor::process() calls it before extraction.
entries.impact: Maliciously crafted archives are blocked before memory/disk exhaustion.

entries.title: LibreOffice Subprocess Must Use posix_spawn with Restricted User
entries.expected: LibreOffice headless subprocess runs under a restricted OS user with no write access to ThemisDB data dir; uses posix_spawn instead of system()
entries.observed: RESOLVED (with CON-001): extractLegacyViaLibreOffice() uses POSIX_SPAWN_RESETIDS (drop SUID/SGID), POSIX_SPAWN_SETPGROUP (isolated process group), minimal sanitised env (HOME=tmpdir), absolute-path validation for soffice binary.
evidence: src/content/office_processor.cpp: posix_spawn flags, minimal envp[], absolute-path check
entries.impact: A malicious document cannot compromise the ThemisDB data directory via the LibreOffice subprocess.
